Answer: D
Reason: The radiograph shows rightward mediastinal shift and reduced right hemithorax volume with a characteristic "kinked" vessel (anomalous venous return), while the remaining right lung demonstrates compensatory hyperaeration; these findings are most consistent with right upper lobe hypoplasia (often associated with Scimitar syndrome) rather than agenesis or simple atelectasis.
